data.rationale: The proposal gets the IMDb → Rotten Tomatoes → email procedure in the right order with the correct subject and body templates, but it gets the last step wrong: it says to send the email, while the true workflow says not to send and to click Discard. It also splits {friend} into separate email and name parameters, adds a '%' that isn't in the template, and adds cookie-banner steps.
